classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. The cube root of 8 is 2; divide the variable exponents by 3. The approved domain decision retains the real cube-root convention.

answer.worked:
The denominator is nonzero when $x\ne0$ and $y\ne0$. Interpret powers with denominator 3 using real cube roots.
$$\begin{align*}\frac1{\sqrt[3]{8x^2y^4}}&=\frac1{\sqrt[3]8\,\sqrt[3]{x^2}\,\sqrt[3]{y^4}}\\\frac1{\sqrt[3]{8x^2y^4}}&=\frac1{2x^{\frac{2}{3}}y^{\frac{4}{3}}}.\end{align*}$$
